Name: Anime HD Portraits
Author: Beornwahl
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QXdCzwP.png[/img]

After seeing Jier's work I decided to add some portraits of my own AI-work in HD. I'm still learning a lot of the tools and have much room for improvements.

The end goal of the project is covering vanilla npc with genderswapped bachelors, the SVE characters (also genderswapped bachelors) and Xtardew Valley.

I'm furthermore considering doing a complete "All Female" portrait overhaul, but several npc lack mods that adds female sprites. So we'll wait and see.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/tzdifyR.png[/img]
The Stardew Valley Expanded portraits are out! You can download them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15512][size=3][b]Anime HD SVE Portraits[/b][/size][/url]

The next update will be the Xtardew Valley portraits - the main reason this mod was made! Soon I'll finally be able to enjoy Expanded/Xtardew compatible portraits in HD!

I've currently started a(nother) play-through and though updates will be more scares I've already noted several aspects for future improvements:

- Size standardization. I think it would be best if all the portraits cover the same amount of the npc - from shoulders to top of head.
- Quality standardization. Some portraits are simply too different in quality and should be redone.
- Style standardization. Some portraits are simply too different in [i]style [/i]and should be redone.
- SVE seems to have changed Claire's portraits for HD, meaning discrepancy between her work and regular clothes. Will look into.
- There something off with the witch's portraits i SVE. Gotta look into that...

[b]Quick FAQ:[/b]

- Will you do seasonal portraits?
- Sadly no. Too massive a task.

- Will you do "insert mod" portraits?
- I only plan to do: vanilla, SVE and Xtardew portraits. Update: and that is now done! So my work is over.

- Where is Krobus and the Dwarf?!?!?!
- You're right, but both of them are done by Vile. See below under credits.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/TgJM9u2.png[/img]
[size=3][b]Make sure you have the following mods installed in advance:

[size=3]1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits [/url]
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - StardewModding API [/url][/size][/b][/size]

[b][size=3]Hereafter download the main file, copy or cut the unzipped folder named Anime HD Portraits to your Mods folder
[b][size=3]

Furthermore, since the mod genderswaps npc to female the mod is meant to be used together with:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2941]Combined girl mod[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia - Female Wizard [/url]

For general genderswapped female sprites and dialouge changes go [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5335]HERE[/url] or see the sprite file under this page's downloads.[/size][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eeWeliC.png[/img]

Credit to Jier and PaulDunstan for their work but for me personally:

- VileBeggar, for his help and explanations. Find his female versions [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14634?tab=description]HERE [/url](has Krobus and Dwarf)
- swyrl, for her efforts and guidance.
- Darklich, for his strides in integration for the Xtardew Anime mod - found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15787]here[/url].
- My mom, for saying I'm a sweet and handsome boy.
[/size][/b]
